title: Quantifying Error Propagation and Model Collapse in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.16601v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly trained or fine-tuned on synthetic data. Recursively training on such data has been observed to significantly degrade performance in a wide range of tasks, often characterized by a progressive drift away from the target distribution. In this work, we theoretically analyze this phenomenon in the setting of score-based diffusion models. For a realistic pipeline where each training round uses a combination of synthetic data and fresh samples from the target distribution, we obtain upper and lower bounds on the accumulated divergence between the generated and target distributions. Notably, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first lower bound on the divergence between the learned and target distributions, even for standard diffusion models. translated_title: 量化扩散模型中的误差传播与模型坍塌
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型越来越多地在合成数据上进行训练或微调。已有观察表明，在这类数据上进行递归训练会在广泛的任务中显著降低性能，通常表现为生成分布逐渐偏离目标分布。在本工作中，我们在基于分数的扩散模型设置下对这一现象进行了理论分析。针对每一轮训练混合使用合成数据与来自目标分布的新鲜样本这一现实训练流程，我们得到了生成分布与目标分布之间累积散度的上界与下界。值得注意的是，据我们所知，这是首个关于学习分布与目标分布之间散度的下界，即使对于标准扩散模型亦是如此。我们的结果使我们能够根据分数估计误差和新鲜数据的使用比例，刻画不同的漂移区间。
tldr: 该论文首次为扩散模型在合成数据上递归训练导致的模型坍塌建立了散度的理论上界与下界，并刻画了分数估计误差与新鲜数据比例如何决定生成分布偏离目标分布的不同漂移区间。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first upper and lower bounds on the divergence accumulated when recursively training diffusion models on synthetic data, characterizing how score estimation error and the proportion of fresh data determine different regimes of model collapse.
